name: dismay
quote: Bummer, I just missed the train.
description: The unpleasant but fleeting experience of something not meeting expectations, often unexpected.

commentaries.quote: Simple dismay is the basic primal negative experience, though it can happen at all levels. There are many complex experiences that create deep-down dismay. For example, at a social level, missing a train may create anxiety about sharing the news with others.

conditions: Something happened in the lower end of the range of expected possible outcomes, but it's not considered dangerous.
